text:
Cleanup is excellent but for now but I have my doubts that they will hold up over time.. This is a good starter set for newlyweds or young adults finally on their own. The Ecolution Easy Clean Non-Stick Cookware cooks food well, as in the heat is distributed throughout the pan. Cleanup is excellent but for now but I have my doubts that they will hold up over time.

I will be recommending this Ecolution Easy Clean Non-Stick Cookware to people wanting to get started in their life, to people looking for a housewarming gift, or for a wedding gift.

The non-stick coating allows food to easily slide around and out of the cookware, making cooking easy and clean up a breeze. The smooth non-stick coating is made without PFOA, so you can cook with confidence for your friends and family. The cookware is all dishwasher safe, so you can let your dishwasher do the dirty work.
